profile.name: ASCII扫描数据文件
profile.description: 一种用于实验扫描结果记录的ASCII列式数据文件，采用以“#”开头的注释行和按行分隔的文本格式，结构类似XDI。它通常用于保存步进扫描或EPICS扫描过程中的时间戳、扫描参数、附加过程变量、列标题和数值数据，便于实验数据归档、交换和后续分析。
profile.description_en: An ASCII column-formatted data file used to record experimental scan results, with line-delimited text and comment lines beginning with '#', in a format derived from XDI. It is typically used to store timestamps, scan parameters, extra process variables, column legends, and numeric data from step scans or EPICS-based scans for archiving, exchange, and later analysis.
